en: (But I'm the one who'll steal that dream...)
It reminds me of my dream for the future.
She seems to be sleeping soundly...
Angela, lend me your strength
How many more people...
will I end up killing like this
Give Agnes any order you wish...
Ahh, my joints ache, for some reason...
Fancy tossing and turning in bed at my age...
Please, give me your orders...
I feel all sluggish, somehow...
Did I eat something bad...?
Morning, handsome!
...Do you want something of me?
What're you on about? Greetings come first!
A cheery "Good morning" to all you meet.
Gets you in the mood to work hard, too.
That is the first I have heard of that...
Ha! Do you usually sleep till it's dark?
No, no, not a fine gentleman like you.
People rise in the morning and sleep at dusk.
London seems to be full of eccentrics...
Are you even walking with your eyes open?
You've got to get some sun on you.
Say, you there, young man.
What was your name again? I'm Agnes.
You don't remember?
Nah, a rugged face like yours,
I'd never forget.
, is it? I'll remember that.
note: After the name; reads after #6349 (msg 258815) and #6452 (msg 259575).

en: Are you getting up in the mornings?
Me, I clean for a living, so I'm up early.
Looking at you, I just can't leave you be.
Eat well, and early to bed, early to rise, OK?
My, I haven't seen your face around.
And you look awfully pale.
Are you all right?
There is no need for concern.
That so? Well, fine, then.
But people ought to rest easy at night.
Name's Agnes. And you are?
I moved to London just recently.
I see. Well, pleased to meet you too.
I expect we'll meet again before long.
What, still wandering about?
Nice night, isn't it, with this breeze.
You're fond of the night, as I recall.
But head home before you tire yourself out.
Hey,
What's wrong, wandering about in a daze?
Just loafing about town is no good.
No, I have a purpose.
I see. Still, you're a man of few words.
I don't mind, so tell me anything you like.
I just can't leave you be, somehow.
Oh my my... Is it fun, watching me clean?
As you can see, this is my job.
Not a grand job, but cleaning matters.
I'm Agnes. I'm here during the day.
Care to join me? Cleaning. Ahahahaha!
No. I may not look it, but I am busy.
That so? Well, I'm fine, as you can see.
You look well too. Good, good.
Shall I clean your house too?
What, back again? You're an odd one.
Say, your house is near here, isn't it?
You keep it nice and clean?
<Of course>
<There's no need>
Really?
You don't look the type to clean,
or to live with family, either.
No, no, no! Living in a dirty house!
Any decent person cleans, at least!
You again?
Can't tell if you're busy or idle, you.
Oh well. Keep your things tidy, hear?
Goodness, I sound just like your mum.
